title: Exa Hits $100M Annualized Revenue After 3 Years of 10x Growth
summary:
The search engine designed for AI agents now processes 2 billion monthly requests for more than 200,000 teams. Exa has reached $100 million in annualized revenue after growing its business by approximately 10x every year for the last three years. The company provides access to hundreds of billions of web documents and proprietary data to users ranging from AI labs to coding and GTM agents.

Company leadership predicts that AI agents will perform 1000x more searches than humans by 2030 because these systems utilize long, complex queries to gather comprehensive information. Exa asserts that the lack of perfect information is currently the primary bottleneck for agent performance, despite advancements in intelligence models such as Fable and Astra.

selectedTweets.bestBit: We now handle 2 billion requests a month from 200k+ teams
selectedTweets.text:
Exa just passed $100m in annualized revenue.

We've grown almost exactly 10x per year for 3 years. We now handle 2 billion requests a month from 200k+ teams. And it’s still so early:

We predict agents will search 1000x more than humans by 2030.

Agents don't search like humans. They write long, complex queries and want all the world's data, not just the web. We've spent 5 years building a search engine designed for them.

We now serve personal agents, AI labs, coding agents, GTM agents, really any agent. Exa gives these agents access to 100s of billions of web documents and tons of proprietary data.

Our customers are increasingly noticing that information is the bottleneck to agent performance. While the world seems close to perfect intelligence with models like Fable and Astra, we are very far from perfect information.

To our small but legendary team, thank you for getting us here, from engineering to research to GTM to ops.

To our customers, it is an honor to serve you. We have some exciting releases coming soon and can't wait to share them 🫡
